primitivefireplace:moddesc: Ring a firepit with stones to make its fuel burn longer.
primitivefireplace:guide-fireplace-text:
Stone fire rings
Banked stones hold the heat in.

Right-click a finished firepit while holding loose stones to set one on the rim. Each click adds a stone; 8 stones complete the ring, and from then on every piece of fuel burns twice as long. The bonus is applied as each piece ignites, so a ring finished mid-burn helps from the next piece onward.

Any rock type works and types can be mixed freely. Sneak and right-click with an empty hand to take the last stone back, and breaking the firepit returns all of them.

Look at the firepit to see how many stones it has and whether the bonus is active.
